title: The Emperor orders a series of shipyards, the dār al-ṣināʿa of the old caliphs, to build a navy that can match the Genoese fleet

data.building: Dar al-Sina'a, a naval building: 'a state naval arsenal producing war galleys and merchant vessels, the backbone of Andalusi maritime power' (the game's text)
data.effects: navy repair speed +1%, monthly sailors +10, local ship-building speed +15%, ship-building capacity +1, can build ships
data.cost: 400 gold at market; 730 days to build; 3,000 workers; takes lumber, naval supplies, tools and masonry
